notes.title: January 8th 2025 Update
notes.content:
Patch Note:

1.New system: Added the CrystalCore system, in 4 round, you can pick 1 of 3 CrystalCores to strength your team.

2.New system: Added the tomb system, when a hero die, he will turn into a tomb. The tomb can’t be covered. After one round, this hero will come back to your hands  

3.Fix some bugs

notes.title: July 18th 2024 Update
notes.content:
Patch Note:

1.Optimized the logic of playing cards: now you can play cards continuously!
2.Optimized the logic of Effects: now the Effects playing without interrupt.
3.Uniformed ATK/DEF/HEL of hovering and normal cards in battle.
4.Added new cards:
(1)Added 8 new Heroes with new skills;
(2)Added 4 new Tech cards;
(3)Added 25 new Servant.
5.Fixed some bugs:
(1)Pressing out cards do not work
(2)When roles’ HEL= 0 on playing turn, he is not die.
(3)Ending volume is too loud.
(4)Game lagging when too many buffs work
(5)Lionheart Researcher’s Bind card working faildly
6.Buff working principle redefined:
(1)Multispell (new): when attack, you can attack the same target again
(2)Huntdown (new): when kill one role, you can attack new target again
(3)Priority: Counterattack > Overload > Pursuit

notes.title: July 4th 2024 Update
notes.content:
Patch Note:

1.Chaos Mode adjusted: updated the distribution of map, adjusted the die effect of the card

2.New system: Achieves now have been opened, there have 50 achieves you can get ( include 2 hidden achieves).

3.Card adjusted: The move cards have been removed, now you can click the card and spend Electron to move.

4.Effect calibrate: open deck effect.

5.Fix some bugs

notes.title: May 31th 2024 Update
notes.content:
Patch Note:

1.New mode has been added: Chaos Mode; Now you can battle with 2 gamers at the same time.

2.Balanced adjustment: we slightly downgraded the growth of some Heroes; And upgraded the attributes of some Servants.

3.Fix some bugs.

4.Add the tips of buff keywords: now you can see what they mean.

notes.title: April 24th 2024 Update
notes.content:
Patch Note:

1.Deck systerm has been improved

2.Game sound effects have been added and improved.

3.In PVE mode, AI will always play monster card so that keep his zone not empty.

4.In PVE mode, monsters' attributes have been adjusted, now their strength rises more gently

5.The monsters can also inherit their attribute improvements now.

6.You know, we solved some bugs.

notes.title: April 9th 2024 Update
notes.content:
Patch Note:

1.In PVE mode, heroes can now inherit buffs, equipment, and attributes. That means you can train your hero without worrying about him being reset next turn!

2.Added resolution selection, now you can adjust game resolution.

3.Optimized the AI algorithm of PVE Mode, now the AI is more powerful and will decide its own way of playing cards depending on the situation: show characters or attribute increase etc.

4.In PVE mode, a new relic store has been added, where you can buy relics to get permanent enhancements.

5.Game effects have been further improved, added the line effects, monster UI effects etc.

6.Game sound effects have been added.

7. Some bugs have been solved.

notes.title: A letter to the Player
notes.content:
After 20 months of development, our product is finally live.
As a debut EA product, we know that there is still a lot of content to be improved in the product, and we also need to stand with players to make our product better and better. Every next two weeks, we will synchronize our work and progress in the community or in the announcement.
Here's what we plan to update in the next two months:
[h3] 1. Development of PVP content[/h3]
Nova Command is a card game built on the PVP model, and the PVP mode has always been regarded as the most important experience content. While we may have a long matchmaking time in a PvP situation without any marketing practices, and players may encounter opponents of different levels or even find no opponents, we still think that the PvP mode will be the most appealing. We will continue to try to solve the problems mentioned above due to the small number of players, including but not limited to increasing the exposure of the product and trying to reach out to partners to expand the scope of influence.
Here's what we're planning to update in PVP mode:

[list]
[*] Add a PVPVP mode to give players a deeper experience of positional strategy gameplay, and at the same time, allow players to have different choices in the battle according to the opponent's different decisions.
[*] Added Friend Play feature.
[/list]

[h3] 2.PVE content production[/h3]
We also value the content experience of PVE. When there are not enough players in a player-versus-player game, it is very important and crucial to experience the fun of core battles through PVE and feel the strategy and content of the game. Although there are many PVE-focused card building games in the past, we are confident that we can shape a different strategy experience for players based on our combat structure. At the same time, PVE gameplay will also be used as the main way for players to be active on a daily basis or to acquire cards.
Work on PVE content is currently focused on the following modules:
[list]
[*] Level monster AI optimization
[*] Production and implementation of PVE-exclusive cards
More and richer level types are produced to increase the depth of development in the PVE process
[/list]

For players who have already purchased the product, but are not satisfied with the product, we sincerely hope to be more patient, and if you choose to get a refund, we hope to have a place on your wishlist, and come back when the time is right. For those players who are still in a wait-and-see state of the product, you can choose to continue to wait and see, or buy the game and leave your suggestions or comments, we very much hope to hear the voice of the players, and have effective communication and discussion with everyone. Grow together.

GeneFree will do our best to maintain the original intention of the studio, with the goal of making innovative products with different experiences in the market, stand with players, and make the products better and better.
